mapper.select: SELECT ti.name as project_name, u.name as student_name, CASE WHEN pss.id IS NOT NULL THEN '已提交' ELSE '未提交' END as submission_status FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id JOIN team_member_student tms ON ti.id = tms.team_id JOIN user_info u ON tms.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN pre_sign_student pss ON ti.id = pss.team_id AND u.id = pss.student WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT year, MAX(award_count) as award_count, MAX(project_count) as project_count FROM ( SELECT ti.year as year, COUNT(a.id) as award_count, 0 as project_count FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id LEFT JOIN award a ON ti.id = a.team_id WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY ti.year UNION ALL SELECT ti.year as year, 0 as award_count, COUNT(ti.id) as project_count FROM team_member_teacher tmt JOIN team_info ti ON tmt.team_id = ti.id WHERE tmt.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY ti.year ) combined GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
